description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing long-term support, improved performance, and modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all source and target compiler settings are updated to 25. Fix any compilation errors or deprecation warnings introduced by the Java 25 migration.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded JDK from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property to 25 and updated Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. Build and all unit tests pass. No CVEs found.
